notes: Original gravimetric (IGA) and volumetric (ASAP 2020) H2 uptake at -196 C, 0-20 bar (and 0-1.1 bar volumetric), measured on the paper's own zeolite-beta-templated N-doped carbons CA800, CA850, CB850, CB850h and on commercial activated carbon G212 (SI Fig. 3S, 5S). Surface areas (BET, N2 at -196 C) are reported for the same samples in Table 1. Buoyancy correction stated (carbon density 1.5 g/cm3, H2 density 0.04 g/cm3). The 'max H2 uptake' column of Table 1 is a Langmuir extrapolation, not a measured point. The paper cites an earlier report on less ordered zeolite-templated carbons (ref 9) but does not state that its H2 values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. record.json is_retracted is false and the PDF shows no retraction notice. Article is a primary research paper in English.
